def parse_fields(text):
    result = []
    i = 0
    n = len(text)
    
    while i < n:
        if text[i] == '\\' and i + 1 < n:
            # Skip the backslash and take the next character literally
            result.append(text[i + 1])
            i += 2
        elif text[i] == ',':
            result.append('')
            i += 1
        else:
            # Accumulate characters until comma or end
            start = i
            while i < n and text[i] != ',':
                i += 1
            result.append(text[start:i])
    
    return result
```
